newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germans seek free mkt wheat, barley export rebates.
newsitem.headline: Germans seek free mkt wheat, barley export rebates.

text.p: German grain traders are seeking export restitutions for 12,000 tonnes of free market soft wheat in a range between 15.99 and 19.99 Ecus per tonne, state grain intervention board BLE said on Thursday.
German traders also sought rebates in a 27.90-30.90 Ecus a tonne range for the intended export of 22,000 tonnes of free market barley, BLE added.
EU grain managers will decide on the bids later today.
